blocks.text: Original document: [docs/EFFECTS.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/EFFECTS.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.

Retiam features a composable, fluent builder API for generating custom WGSL fragment shaders for both strokes (`PathEffect`) and fills (`FillEffect`). These effects are injected directly into the rendering pipeline, allowing complex, performant procedural styling without manually writing WGSL.

The effects system uses a **Builder Pattern**. You can chain multiple effects sequentially. Under the hood, the engine compiles the chain into uniquely-named WGSL helper functions, passing the output of each stage as the input to the next.
`PathEffect` manipulates the stroke of lines, paths, and parametric curves. It provides control over color, alpha, thickness, and patterns along the path length (`t`).

cells.text: Interpolates between an array of `Color` objects along the path length.
Simple dash-gap pattern based on world-space lengths.
Complex dash pattern array (e.g. `[on, off, on, off]`). Odd-length arrays auto-double per SVG spec.

blocks.text: **Note on Anchoring:** `Dashed` and `DotDash` support an `anchorEnd` boolean parameter. When `true`, the pattern distance is measured from the **tail** (end) of the path instead of the head. This is essential for dynamic paths (like `TracePath`) to prevent the dashes from "swimming" or shifting as the path grows.

cells.text: Softens the stroke edges, leaving a solid core and a soft falloff.
Smoothly ramps the stroke width from thin to full at the start/end regions.
Sinusoidal width modulation that creates a wavy stroke edge.
A trail effect that tapers width and fades alpha toward the tail (t=0). Ideal for `TracePath`.
Fades the stroke alpha smoothly at both endpoints.
Simple alpha multiplier for translucent strokes.

blocks.text: `FillEffect` manipulates the interior fill of 2D primitives like `Circle`, `Poly`, and closed `Path`s. It operates on local 2D spatial coordinates (`localPos`).

cells.text: Linear gradient between two points in local space.
Radial gradient expanding from a center point.
Directional stripe pattern at any angle (in degrees).
Radial darkening effect toward the edges.

blocks.text: Multiple effect instances can be combined into a single unified chain using `PathEffect.combine()` and `FillEffect.combine()`:

When creating a `Path`, `Rect`, `Circle`, `Ellipse`, or `SVG`, you pass effects directly via `strokeShader` and `fillShader`. Both accept a single effect or an array of effects to cascade automatically:
Entities that accept a `shader` parameter (like `TracePath`, `Path`, `Line3D`) accept either a compiled `PathEffect`/`FillEffect` instance, or a raw WGSL string for fully custom behavior.

items: **Path Shaders** must implement: `fn pathEffect(t: f32, total_arc_len: f32, w: f32, col: vec4f) -> vec4f`
**Fill Shaders** must implement: `fn fillEffect(localPos: vec2f, col: vec4f) -> vec4f`
